findings.statusNote: Owner's decision 1, 2026-11-13: The stock items list that orders, receiving, shipping and invoices update is the real stock, and sales orders are the real orders. The second stock list and the order hub are to be connected to them or retired, never built on separately. Decided by the owner (decision 1): the stock items list and sales orders are the real ones. Phase 2 put both second copies under a department rule and inside the gates; it did not connect or retire them. Phase 3 audited the two stores and did not migrate them. The QA database holds only fixture rows in them; what the live stores hold cannot be seen from here, and moving records nobody has inspected into the order and stock tables would be changing business data on a guess.
